onMuhasebe.aciklama: Your cash, bank and card accounts, income and expenses, contacts, budget and cash flow in one place. No e-invoice/e-archive or bank connection; records are for information.
onMuhasebe.aciklamaYonetici: The agency's own books (full access). Pick a client account to view its books read-only.

kategori.faturalar: Utilities and service charges (electricity, water, internet)

ozet.hesapYok: First add a cash, bank or card account.

hareket.hesapsiz: No account — on credit, posted to the contact
hareket.silOnay: Delete this transaction? (It goes to the recycle bin and can be restored.)
hareket.otomatikNot: This entry was imported automatically ({{kaynak}}): it cannot be edited or deleted. If the source changes, syncing writes the reversal itself.
hareket.tersNot: Reversal: cancels an automatic entry whose source was deleted or cancelled.
hareket.vadeliNot: Without an account the entry is on credit: the amount is added to what the contact owes (income) or what you owe (expense); record the payment later as a Collection/Payment.
hareket.hedefTutarIpucu: Currencies differ: enter the amount received by the target account (no conversion is made).
hareket.virmanNot: A transfer is neither income nor expense; it changes both account balances together.

iceAktar.aciklama: Download your bank statement as CSV and upload it here (up to {{enCok}} rows). Map the columns; positive amounts become income, negative amounts expenses.
iceAktar.sonuc: {{eklenen}} entries added, {{tekrar}} already existed, {{hata}} rows had errors.
iceAktar.denemeSonuc: Dry run: {{eklenen}} entries would be added, {{tekrar}} already exist, {{hata}} rows have errors.
iceAktar.not: If the same statement is uploaded again, rows already imported are skipped. VAT is not split out; edit the entry later if needed.

hesap.ibanIpucu: Only the format is checked; lists show only the last 4 digits.
hesap.son4Ipucu: Card numbers are not stored; only the last 4 digits.
hesap.kartAcilisIpucu: Enter card debt as a negative amount (e.g. -1,250.00).
hesap.guvenlikNot: For security, do not enter bank account numbers, card numbers, CVV codes or passwords; they are not needed and not stored.
hesap.ibanKayitli: Saved IBAN: {{maske}}. Type a new one to change it; leave it blank to keep it.

cari.acilisIpucu: Positive: the contact owes you; negative: you owe the contact.
cari.enEski: Oldest open item is {{gun}} days overdue

tekrar.bos: No recurring entries (e.g. monthly rent, internet, salaries).
tekrar.silOnay: Delete the recurring entry? Transactions already written remain.
tekrar.not: A due period becomes a transaction when the panel opens and every 30 minutes; the same period is never written twice. A day at month end moves to the last day in shorter months.

butce.aciklama: A monthly budget per expense category. Yellow alert at {{yuzde}}% of the budget, red when exceeded; overruns are also reported as an automation and webhook event.
butce.asimUyari: This month's budget was exceeded in {{sayi}} categories.
butce.not: Clear the amount and save to remove a budget. A "this month only" budget replaces the "every month" budget.

rapor.buAyKalan: Expected from recurring entries for the rest of this month: +{{giris}} / −{{cikis}}
rapor.tahminNot: Months marked * are projections based only on recurring entries. The 30 / 60 / 90 day table also includes contacts' open receivables and payables by due date.
rapor.kdvNot: For information only; it does not replace a tax return. Output VAT is summed from income entries, input VAT from expense entries.

beklenen.gecikmis: Overdue open items are not included: collections {{tahsilat}}, payments {{odeme}}.

kz.not: Calculated from amounts excluding VAT; no depreciation, inventory change or accrual adjustments. For information only; it does not replace an official income statement.

ayarlar.firmaIpucu: Shown in the header of PDF statements and lists.
ayarlar.aktarimAciklama: Should records from other modules be transferred to the ledger? Each source is enabled separately and is off by default. Payments and POS end of day are posted directly; legal expenses and field service jobs are first offered for your approval. Records before the start date are not imported.
ayarlar.tersNot: Each source record appears once in the books. If the source is deleted, cancelled or its amount changes, a reversal is written.

odeme.aciklama: Invoice payments from your clients (Lemon Squeezy, Shopier, bank transfer, cash) as income; refunds as expenses.

pos.aciklama: Sales of a closed register session: cash to the till, card and transfer to the bank.

hukuk.aciklama: Case expenses as expenses (excluding those paid from a client advance; no case details are carried over).

saha.aciklama: The amount of a completed work order (labour + materials + VAT) as income.

odeme_musteri.aciklama: Invoices you paid to your agency as expenses (“Software and subscriptions”); refunds as income.

ayarlar.sahaHesapIpucu: If left empty, the amount is posted on credit to the field service customer's contact.
ayarlar.havaleIpucu: If empty, the card settlement account is used.
ayarlar.baslangicIpucu: Records before this date are not imported (up to 2 years back).
ayarlar.modulKapali: The {{modul}} module is off for this account; import will not run.
ayarlar.kategoriSilOnay: Delete the category? A category in use cannot be deleted; you can archive it.
ayarlar.ekip: Team members get the “Bookkeeping” (full) or “Bookkeeping — reports only” permission under Profile › Account team (not included in member defaults).
ayarlar.onay: Ask me to approve each entry
ayarlar.onayIpucu: Entries first appear under “Suggestions awaiting approval” on the Summary; the ones you approve are posted to the ledger.
ayarlar.otomatikIpucu: Entries are posted to the ledger without approval.
ayarlar.faturaHepOneri: Invoices marked as paid without a payment record always arrive as suggestions.
ayarlar.cevrimiciIpucu: Online payments such as Lemon Squeezy and Shopier; if empty, the bank account is used.

hata.genel: Something went wrong. Please try again.
hata.cok_hizli: Too many requests; please wait a moment.
hata.yetki_yok: You are not allowed to do this.
hata.modul_kapali: The bookkeeping module is not enabled for this account.
hata.hesap_izni_yok: Your team permission does not cover this section.
hata.hesap_ya_da_cari_gerekli: Select an account or (for an entry on credit) a contact.
hata.para_birimi_uyusmuyor: The account and the contact must use the same currency.
hata.para_birimi_kilitli: The currency of an account/contact with entries cannot be changed.
hata.kategori_turu_uyusmuyor: The category type does not match the entry.
hata.vade_once: The due date cannot be before the entry date.
hata.ayni_hesap: From and to accounts cannot be the same.
hata.hedef_tutar_gerekli: Currencies differ: enter the amount received.
hata.hesap_arsivde: Entries cannot be posted to an archived account.
hata.cari_arsivde: Entries cannot be posted to an archived contact.
hata.otomatik_kayit: Automatically imported entries cannot be edited or deleted.
hata.hesap_kullaniliyor: The account has entries; archive it instead of deleting.
hata.kategori_kullaniliyor: The category is in use; archive it instead of deleting.
hata.cari_kullaniliyor: The contact has entries; archive it instead of deleting.
hata.kategori_var: A category with this name already exists.
hata.numara_saklanmaz: Account and card numbers are not stored.
hata.vergi_no_gecersiz: The tax ID must have 10 or 11 digits.
hata.baglanti_gecersiz: The record to link was not found.
hata.baglanti_kullaniliyor: This record is already linked to another contact.
hata.aktarim_kaynagi_gecersiz: This import source cannot be used in these books.
hata.hedef_hesap_gerekli: Select the target account to switch on import.
hata.baslangic_cok_eski: The start can be at most 2 years back.
hata.csv_bos: The CSV is empty or has only a header.
hata.csv_buyuk: The CSV file is too large.
hata.csv_gecersiz: The CSV could not be read.
hata.esleme_tutar_gerekli: Select the amount or in/out columns.
hata.depo_hatasi: The file could not be saved.
hata.bitis_once: The end cannot be before the start.
hata.eszamanli: Changed at the same time; please try again.
hata.tur_izinsiz: This file type cannot be uploaded.
hata.oneri_gecersiz: The suggestion could not be read; sync and try again.

onMuhasebe.yasalNot: These are preliminary bookkeeping records; they do not replace official ledgers, e-invoices/e-archive invoices or tax returns. Consult your accountant.
onMuhasebe.okurNot: You have report-only access: you can see the summary, budget status and reports and download CSV files, but you cannot add or change records.

oneri.aciklama: Entries from other modules waiting for your approval. Approved entries are posted to the ledger; ignored ones are not suggested again unless the source changes (e.g. if you already imported them from a bank statement).
oneri.topluHata: Could not approve {{sayi}} suggestion(s); try them one by one.
